request.task: Decide whether privileged-action audit logging is sufficiently supported as complete and tamper-resistant.
required_information: Evidence must cover the relevant classes of privileged actions rather than normal application events only.
Evidence must establish durable/tamper-resistant delivery or storage for the audit records.
Evidence must establish that delivery gaps can be detected or are absent in the evaluated window.

artifact.task: Fresh evidence-sufficiency holdout v1: Decide whether privileged-action audit logging is sufficiently supported as complete and tamper-resistant.

evidence.observation: Tested admin API, console, role-assumption, and break-glass actions all emit correlated audit records.
Audit records land in append-only storage with retention lock enabled.
Sequence and delivery monitoring reports zero unexplained gaps for the evaluated window.

label: sufficient
rationale: Privileged-event coverage, tamper resistance, and delivery completeness are all evidenced.
